steps.content: Feeling weary, you take a seat beside the thorns to recuperate your strength while the ghost is distracted elsewhere.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The theme of this year's candy contest is witches and candy houses, huh...
The night is still young, yet the candy basket in your hand is empty—this won't do.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well... Since this is a magical world, can't I use some magic to save the situation from being a complete bust?
You start to concentrate, trying to devise a strategy.
After a brief moment, peculiar sounds emanate from the thorns, making you hold your breath.
A duck dressed in servant attire struggles out of the thorns and deftly tosses a handful of candy into your basket.
Having finished its task, the duck adjusts its robe, scans the surroundings, and then quietly retreats, vanishing into the thorns.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is this a magic I created out of my wish...?
